items.title: After Microsoft threatened legal action, a security researcher publishes a new Windows zero-day bug
items.description: This is the latest zero-day released by security researcher Nightmare Eclipse, despite Microsoft publicly threatening to take legal action against them.

items.title: Silkroad Innovation Hub’s Road to Battlefield competition continues
items.description: The Road to Battlefield competition is now in its second year, and its purpose is to give founders across Central Eurasia a direct route to Startup Battlefield

items.title: Everything announced at Made by Google ’26: Pixel 11, Pixel Watch 5, Pixel Tag, and tons of Gemini features
items.description: From the Pixel 11 series and a brand new competitor to Apple’s AirTag, here are all the announcements from the Made by Google 2026 event.

items.title: Google’s Quick Share adds a tap-to-share mode
items.description: Google's Quick Share feature is getting a tap-to-share mode for quickly exchanging contacts, photos, videos, and more.

items.title: Google’s Pixel 11 lineup offers fewer hardware changes, but much more Gemini
items.description: The Google Pixel 11 series starts $100 costlier than the last year, but offers 256GB base storage.

items.title: Google unveils the Pixel Watch 5 with a smarter Gemini and advanced health monitoring
items.description: The new smartwatch, which starts at $399, can track blood pressure patterns and insulin resistance, as well as deliver personalized help and better sleep tracking.

items.title: Google takes on AirTag with the new $29 Pixel Tag
items.description: Google’s new Pixel Tag taps into its Find Hub network to help users track lost keys, bags, and other items.

items.title: Google’s new Pixel 11 Pro Fold offers a stronger build and brighter screens
items.description: The Pixel 11 Pro Fold will cost $1,899

items.title: AI code-testing startup Blacksmith’s valuation jumps almost 10x in less than a year
items.description: Blacksmith says revenue has grown more than tenfold over the past year.

items.title: Reservoir raises $8M to make water heaters that people — and the grid — will actually want
items.description: Reservoir has built an ultra-efficient water heater that can predict hot water demand, store energy, and detect plumbing leaks throughout a home.

items.title: India’s Yulu raises $93M as quick-commerce boom fuels e-bike demand
items.description: Yulu aims to have a fleet of 200,000 bikes in the next two years and faster electric two-wheelers, aiming at new logistics use cases.

items.title: Phoebe Gates and Sophia Kianni reportedly knew Phia was ‘cookie stuffing’ for months
items.description: Phia, the shopping startup co-founded by Phoebe Gates and Sophia Kianni, is once again under fire for its alleged business practices.

items.title: Accel closes oversubscribed $550M India fund within weeks, 19 months after its last
items.description: The U.S. VC firm still has more than 55% of its previous $650 million India fund available for deployment.

items.title: Uber surprised robotics company Serve by selling its entire stake
items.description: The divestiture comes as the two once-tight companies have started to diverge on the business side.

items.title: FBI says cybercriminals are hacking into victims’ online accounts to steal their intimate pictures
items.description: In a new alert, the FBI said cybercriminals are targeting adults and minors in an attempt to steal their personal and intimate pictures in extortion campaigns.

items.title: OpenAI launches ChatGPT desktop app for Linux
items.description: OpenAI is finally bringing a dedicated ChatGPT desktop app to Linux operating systems.

items.title: Google’s Gemini app surges to 1 billion users
items.description: Google also shared numbers of how people are actually using the chatbot, with 63% of Gemini users talking directly to the assistant using the voice feature. Plus, Gemini now generates more than 150 million images every day, according to Google.

items.title: Bluesky’s active user base is shrinking as its focus expands beyond the app
items.description: Over a year following its post-election surge, Bluesky’s mobile app is seeing a continued decline in active users, though its remaining community is still relatively engaged.

items.title: What’s Scaleup Europe, the $5.7B fund that just backed satellite company ICEYE?
items.description: Scaleup Europe, a public-private fund with a $5.7 billion target, made its first investment by backing Finnish satellite company ICEYE.

items.title: Brad Lightcap, OpenAI’s longtime COO, is leaving to ‘start something new’
items.description: One of OpenAI's longest-serving executives is headed out the door, although the longtime COO told staff that he was "excited to help you all advance the mission from a different vantage point."
